statement: A rectangular sheet of cardboard is $30$ inches long and $20$ inches wide. A square with side length $x$ inches is cut from each corner, and the sides are folded up to make an open-top box. The bottom of the box has an area of $144$ square inches. What is the volume of the box, in cubic inches?

choices.misconception: I thought the height of the box was $2x = 12$ because squares are cut from both sides, so I computed $144 \times 12$.
I solved $(30 - 2x)(20 - 2x) = 144$ and used the root $x = 19$ without checking that the sides would be negative, so I got $144 \times 19$.
I found $x = 6$ but multiplied it by the area of the original sheet, $30 \times 20 = 600$, instead of the area of the bottom.

hints: Write the length and width of the bottom of the box in terms of $x$.
The bottom measures $(30 - 2x)$ by $(20 - 2x)$. Set the product equal to $144$ and keep only a root that gives positive lengths.
The two bottom dimensions differ by $10$ and multiply to $144$, so they are $18$ and $8$, which gives $x = 6$. The height of the box is $x$.

solutions.reliable: The bottom of the box is $(30 - 2x)$ by $(20 - 2x)$, so $(30 - 2x)(20 - 2x) = 144$. Expanding, $4x^2 - 100x + 600 = 144$, so $x^2 - 25x + 114 = 0$, which factors as $(x - 6)(x - 19) = 0$. The root $x = 19$ would make $20 - 2x$ negative, so $x = 6$. The bottom is $18$ by $8$ and the height is $6$, so the volume is $144 \times 6 = 864$ cubic inches.
solutions.elegant: The length and width of the bottom always differ by $30 - 20 = 10$. Two positive numbers that differ by $10$ and multiply to $144$ are $18$ and $8$, so $x = (20 - 8) \div 2 = 6$ and the volume is $144 \times 6 = 864$.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
